page.notes: Left strip: edge of the neighbouring page, not transcribed. The running head and page number are read from the printed line at the top. The catchword "Rem-" sits at the right under the last line; the signature "M 2" sits centred under it. Doubtful: "falsuginem" (the word is printed with a plain s and may be intended as salsuginem). The reference mark "n" in the text is matched to the margin note "Lib.6. cap.19.", which is set beside the line of "Socrates".
